page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz, equipped with a 48 MB L3 cache. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates average performance across most compute and memory operations. The instance achieved a single-core stress-ng score of 1865.39 and a multi-core score of 30983.52. Large-block memory bandwidth tests show read speeds of 141.73 GB/sec and write speeds of 65.94 GB/sec. For specialized workloads, the server demonstrates strong text generation performance on small language models, reaching 282.15 tokens per second, while medium-sized model inference runs at an average rate of 17.54 tokens per second.

Given its high memory density and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require local NVMe storage. The absence of bundled local storage means users must factor in network storage performance and costs. The hardware profile is suited for memory-intensive applications such as in-memory databases, Redis caching layers, large-scale data processing, and enterprise applications requiring high RAM-to-vCPU ratios.
